2608.03994.title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
2608.03994.paper_summary: We identify a previously overlooked failure mode of ALiBi positional encoding: its linear bias scaling underflows floating-point precision, which zeroes out a large fraction of attention weights and renders the affected attention heads partially blind. We analyze this failure mode, characterize its impact, and examine four mitigation strategies. We further demonstrate its occurrence in state-of-the-art pretrained models based on ALiBi. Comprehensive pretraining experiments with 148M-parameter decoder models help us to disentangle its effects from out-of-context degradation. We find that ALiBi's failure mode can substantially impair token retrieval while having only a minor effect on standard decoder benchmarks. We propose four training-time mitigation strategies and evaluate them individually and in combinations, finding that log-scaled distances yield the most consistent improvements in passkey retrieval. Despite this problem, default ALiBi slopes remain a surprisingly strong baseline, particularly for needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Based on these findings we provide concrete recommendations on how to train models with ALiBi.
2608.03994.paper_summary_zh: 我們識別出一種先前被忽視的 ALiBi 位置編碼失效模式：其線性偏差縮放使浮點精度下溢，這使得大量的注意力權重變為零，並使受影響的注意力頭部分失去功能。我們分析了這一失效模式，描述了其影響，並檢查了四種緩解策略。我們進一步展示了其在基於 ALiBi 的最先進預訓練模型中的出現。對 148M 參數解碼器模型的全面預訓練實驗幫助我們將其影響與上下文外的退化分開。我們發現 ALiBi 的失效模式可以顯著損害標記檢索，同時對標準解碼器基準的影響則相對較小。我們提出了四種訓練時的緩解策略，並單獨及組合評估它們，發現對數縮放距離在密碼檢索中產生了最一致的改進。儘管存在這個問題，默認的 ALiBi 斜率仍然是一個驚人強大的基準，特別是在針對難以檢索的情況下。根據這些發現，我們提供了具體的建議，說明如何使用 ALiBi 訓練模型。
